verdict.rationale: The probe shows no llms.txt (HTTP 404). However, Poly does publish agent-oriented material: the official `poly-cli` agent skill teaches an agent how to search, read, create and organize files via `poly` commands. The Claude Code plugin also 'teaches Claude how to use Poly', and the docs are served as raw Markdown under /raw/ paths that an agent can read directly. missing for 10: an llms.txt / llms-full.txt index, explicit documentation that the raw Markdown docs are intended for agents, and independent hands-on corroboration.
